Current internal model: View A is almost certainly attending the right location (selection probability 0.9986). That right object is very likely red and square (color ≈ 1.0 red; shape ≈ 0.99 square). View B is almost certainly attending the lower location (selection probability 0.9985). That lower object in B is very likely green and a cross (color ≈ 1.0 green; shape = cross). Other locations in both views have only very low current selection probabilities and distinct likely labels: A‑upper yellow circle, A‑lower blue triangle, A‑left green cross; B‑upper red triangle, B‑right blue square, B‑left yellow circle.

Recoverability for the currently attended items: A-right ~0.43 now, ~0.31 after one step, ~0.22 after two steps; B-lower ~0.29 now, ~0.21 after one step, ~0.16 after two.

If you issue a redirection command, predicted next selections change according to the model: in View A, commands “upper/left/lower” barely shift selection (right remains ~0.9999 for “right”); in View B, “upper/right/lower/left” mostly map to selecting the upper/right/lower/left probabilities shown (e.g., command “right” predicts selecting B‑right with ~0.994).
